cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Steer the Suspicion
cards.instruction: Hide your responsibility by redirecting every new clue toward a safer explanation before anyone can connect it back to you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Your shelf fell because they supplied the wrong bracket.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You fitted it upside down. Look at the arrow.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. That's a misleading arrow. We should photograph it for the manufacturer.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You drew that arrow. I watched you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Because theirs was missing. Put that in the complaint; they made us supply our own safety markings.

mechanism: A acts as the competent claims investigator while redefining their own installation evidence as manufacturer fault.
confusable: A conspiracy explanation alone lacks S03; A should correct B's interpretation and direct what gets documented.
comparison: Own assembly responsibility differs from the delivery-stain scene's disputed transfer route.
seedUse: Keep reversed bracket and self-drawn arrow, making A supervise photographs while shifting blame.
